visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a modern airplane business class cabin with warm, ambient lighting. A woman's hand holds a glass of milk on a dark console, while a baby dressed in a blue onesie sleeps peacefully on a padded seat. Green and white variety text appears in the center. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the woman's legs, wearing black pants and blue sneakers, stretching out into a spacious footwell that contains a silver-wrapped pillow. (3) A large, bright entertainment screen displays a movie, reflecting the woman's silhouette as she holds the baby. A sliding door with a red lock indicator is shown being pulled shut, creating a private suite environment. (4) A storage compartment is opened to reveal a wireless charging pad, several USB ports, and a touch-screen controller. A beige branded amenity kit bag is then presented and opened, showing various items inside like an eye mask and skincare. (5) Close-ups of a red 'Oneluxe' face mask packet and a bottle of 'Pure Bliss' organic baby formula are shown being held by a hand. (6) A hand flips through a 'White Wine' menu, followed by a sequence of gourmet food shots: a glass of white wine next to a salad with a purple orchid, a cocktail with a tea bag, and a main course of stewed meat with vegetables. (7) The woman and baby are seen resting together under a grey blanket, both appearing to sleep. The woman is later shown wearing a brown sweatshirt and glasses, giving a thumbs-up. (8) The final sequence features more meals, including a burger and a traditional breakfast tray with congee and side dishes. The woman concludes by holding up a small glass of milk toward the camera, smiling with the baby in her lap.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 帶小孩搭星宇商務艙. (2) [Logo]: @hithisisachi. (3) [Subtitle]: 欸, 帶小孩搭星宇商務艙是什麼樣的體驗呢? (4) [Subtitle]: 我們這次搭西雅圖飛台北的商務艙. (5) [Subtitle]: 空間真的是非常的大腳完全碰不到底. (6) [Subtitle]: 星宇的飛機真的很新有超極大的電視螢幕. (7) [Subtitle]: 座位門還可以拉起來哺乳非常方便. (8) [Subtitle]: 旁邊的收納空間也很足夠甚至還有無線充電. (9) [Logo]: THREE. (10) [Subtitle]: 過夜包的設計很簡約看起來很高及. (11) [Logo]: Oneluxe. (12) [Subtitle]: 甚至還有給面膜喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 選酒非常特別. (14) [Subtitle]: 甚至有埔里來的白酒. (15) [Subtitle]: 但我還是覺得調酒更好喝一點. (16) [Subtitle]: 吃飯時我是盤腿讓小孩睡在我兩腿中間. (17) [Subtitle]: 燉羊膝超美味是北每起飛商務艙最好吃的. (18) [Logo]: Pure Bliss. (19) [Subtitle]: 嬰兒餐很豐盛但我們只拿了水奶. (20) [Subtitle]: 不過甜點實在是不怎麼樣特別芝麻糊我沒有辦法理解. (21) [Subtitle]: 空間不是很寬但夠我跟寶寶兩個人側躺. (22) [Subtitle]: 睡衣非常實際因為我原本的衣服已經超臭了. (23) [Subtitle]: 點心跟早餐我覺得都普普通通但我很愛他們的紅豆水. (24) [Subtitle]: 重點是能跟寶寶舒舒服服的搭機服務人員都很親切會一直來問有什麼需要幫忙的. (25) [Subtitle]: 很推薦大家嘗試看看喔.
